hooks.text: 税费扣除后的微薄工资就是成长资源，需要用剩余薪水购买卡牌强化战斗能力。
hooks.excerpt: In order to survive against increasingly powerful enemies, you’ll need to use what remains of your meager salary after taxes and other expenses are deducted to purchase cards and develop your combat capabilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 操作被压缩为移动、瞄准、射击和使用装置四项，面向高速射击节奏。
hooks.excerpt: The controls are simple: you’ll only need to move, aim, shoot, and use gadgets.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 为寻找失联的精英部队姐姐，斯涅任卡加入私人军事公司并奔赴战场。
hooks.excerpt: Snezhinka’s older sister is a member of the elite Molten Iron Squadron. One day, Snezhinka abruptly loses contact with her sister, prompting her to join the private military company Blue Peacock Co. and head for the front lines of the war in order to bring her sister home.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
